title: chmod Calculator
description: Build Unix file permissions from read, write and execute boxes, or decode an octal mode like 755. Runs locally. Nothing is uploaded.
intro: Tick owner, group and other permissions to get the octal mode, symbolic string and a chmod command. Or decode an octal value the other way.
blurb: Convert between chmod checkboxes, octal modes and symbolic permissions.
howItWorks: Tick read, write and execute for owner, group and other, then press From checkboxes.
Or type a three-digit octal mode and press Decode octal to fill the meaning.
Copy the chmod command. Special bits such as setuid are not included.
examples: Owner read/write and everyone else read is 644, shown as rw-r--r--.
Owner rwx and group/other r-x is 755, a common directory mode.
Typing 600 decodes to owner read and write only.

faq.a: Each class sums read=4, write=2 and execute=1. 7 is rwx, 6 is rw-, 5 is r-x and 4 is r--.

faq.q: Does this change files on a server?
faq.a: No. It only prints the command. Run chmod yourself on the machine that owns the file.

faq.q: Are setuid and sticky bits included?
faq.a: No. This calculator covers the standard three-digit owner, group and other mode.
